description: This file defines the Banner controller class within the Opencart Admin module. It manages CRUD operations, listing, and status toggling for banner entities in the admin interface, including rendering views and handling form submissions.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing banner entities within the Opencart admin interface, providing methods for listing, editing, creating, enabling/disabling, and deleting banners.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point for displaying the banner list page, setting up the view with necessary data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to fetch and output the list of banners.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the data for the banner list view, including banners, pagination, and sorting.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the banner creation/edit form, pre-loading data if editing an existing banner.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating banners, with validation and JSON response.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected banners by updating their status.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected banners by updating their status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected banners from the system.
